instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts for Playfair Display (font-serif) and Outfit (font-sans) in index.html.
Install recharts for the calculators and ensure charts use the brand colors (chart_1 to chart_5).
Build the calculators logically. Ex: SIP Calculator needs monthly investment, duration, expected return rate, and an AreaChart visualization of invested amount vs total value.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) for testing.
Ensure all buttons have proper hover and focus states (higher contrast).
Use backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/80 for the sticky navigation header so the content behind it slightly blurs.
